admin.impIntro: Aggregated indicators of network activity, in real time.

admin.revClosedOrIdle: No review under way: assigning a reviewer opens one.
admin.dirHint: The application only collects a free-text country. Fill these fields to publish the entry in the directory on approval.
admin.dirLaterHint: The account is created and the member can sign in; the entry still needs completing before it appears in the directory.
admin.dirIncomplete: Provide a country code, a region, at least one theme and one language.
admin.inviteHint: Opens an account and sends an invitation to sign in with a code. Without this, no account can be created outside approving an application.
admin.inviteExisting: This account already existed: invitation resent, role unchanged.
admin.inviteError: The invitation failed. Check the address.
admin.confirmRejectAppBody: This decision is final: a rejected application can no longer be re-decided from this screen.
admin.confirmRejectPubBody: The publication leaves the queue and goes back to its author, who is notified. To put it back under review, reopen it from the “All” filter.
admin.confirmRemoveBody: The content disappears from the tribune for everyone. Reported excerpt: “{excerpt}”
admin.confirmRoleBody: Their role changes from “{from}” to “{to}”. The matching permissions take effect immediately.
admin.feedbackReportDismissed: Report dismissed: the content stays online.
admin.feedbackError: Action not completed. Check your permissions, then try again.
admin.aiIntro: A model reviews each submission against the criteria defined here, then publishes it if nothing stands in the way, or sends it back to you. The model's opinion never decides alone: the server rechecks the mode, the scope and the threshold when applying it.
admin.aiNotConfigured: No gateway key is set on this deployment: no analysis is possible and submissions stay in the human queue. Set AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY on the Convex environment.
admin.aiModeHint_off: No calls. The queue stays entirely human.
admin.aiModeHint_shadow: The model analyses and the log records, but nothing shows in the queue: use it to calibrate a rulebook on real submissions without influencing decisions.
admin.aiModeHint_assist: The opinion shows in the moderation queue. The decision stays human.
admin.aiModeHint_auto: A submission with no signal, above the confidence threshold and within the chosen scope, is published without human review.
admin.aiModeAutoWarning: Under auto-publish, texts will appear under the association's name without a human having read them. Check the rulebook and the scope before arming this mode.
admin.aiModelHint: Identifier from the Vercel gateway catalogue, for example anthropic/claude-opus-5.
admin.aiFallbackHint: Tried once if the first one fails. Leave empty for none.
admin.aiConfidenceHint: Below it, the submission goes to the human queue. The threshold does not arbitrate between publishing and rejecting, but between publishing and asking someone.
admin.aiScopeHint: No type ticked: nothing is published automatically, whatever the mode. Analysis still covers every submission.
admin.aiAttachmentsLabel: Send the attached PDF to the model
admin.aiAttachmentsHint: Without reading the PDF, the opinion covers metadata only — and a submission whose file was not read is never auto-published.
admin.aiMaxAttachmentLabel: Maximum size of the analysed PDF (MB)
admin.aiDailyCapHint: Once reached, submissions go to the human queue instead of being analysed.
admin.aiInstructionsHint: The house editorial line, spelled out. Criteria checked one by one are written below, in the rulebook.
admin.aiInstructionsPlaceholder: e.g. favour sourced work and verifiable data; reject partisan statements naming individuals…
admin.aiRulesIntro: Each criterion is submitted to the model exactly as written here. Word it as a question answered by “the document satisfies it” or “the document triggers this signal”.
admin.aiRulesEmpty: No criteria yet: only the safety floor applies.
admin.aiRuleDescriptionPlaceholder: Does the document cite its sources verifiably (references, datasets, methodology)?
admin.aiSeverityHint_blocking: Prevents auto-publishing and alerts the team.
admin.aiSeverityHint_info: Prevents nothing; recorded in the log.
admin.aiBaselineIntro: Always evaluated, on top of your rulebook, and cannot be switched off.
admin.aiConfirmDeleteRuleBody: Opinions already given keep it; future analyses will no longer evaluate it.
admin.aiTestIntro: Try the rulebook on a text without publishing or saving anything. The model call is real: it counts against the daily cap.
admin.aiTestWouldPublish: This submission would be published automatically.
admin.aiTestWouldEscalate: This submission would go to the human queue: {reason}
admin.aiReason_mode_assist: assist mode: the decision is human
admin.aiReason_attachment_not_read: attachment not read by the model
admin.aiAnalyzeScheduled: Analysis requested: the opinion will appear shortly.
admin.aiConfirmRevertTitle: Send “{title}” back to the moderation queue?

accounts.dataIntro: You can download all the data linked to your account at any time, or delete your account.
accounts.exportHint: A JSON file with your account, contributions, registrations, affiliations and notifications. It contains neither your password nor your second factor.
accounts.exportError: The export failed. Try again in a moment.
accounts.deleteRule: Deletion is permanent. Your personal data is erased: sessions, sign-in methods, two-factor authentication, notifications, affiliations, applications, unpublished submissions, Tribune posts and comments. Your publications already in the library stay online, no longer linked to your account.
accounts.deleteConfirmBody: A confirmation code will be sent to {email}. The deletion only happens once you enter it.
accounts.deleteCodeSent: A code has been sent to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
accounts.deleteDone: Your account is being deleted. You are about to be signed out.
accounts.errGeneric: The action failed. Please try again.
accounts.err_EXPIRED: This code has expired. Request a new one.
accounts.err_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts: request a new code.
accounts.err_NO_REQUEST: No request in progress: request a code first.
accounts.err_LAST_ADMIN: Not possible: this is the last active administrator. Appoint another one first.
accounts.err_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again in an hour.
accounts.err_EMAIL_PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: No email provider is configured: the code cannot be sent. Contact the secretariat.
accounts.createHint: Opens the account immediately and sends a welcome email to sign in with a code. An address already known is not changed: the email is sent again and the affiliation added.
accounts.createExisting: This account already existed: welcome email sent again, role unchanged.
accounts.createNoEmail: Warning: no email provider is configured, the email will not be sent.
accounts.selfActionsLocked: Actions unavailable on your own account.
accounts.suspendReasonHint: It is logged and visible to administrators.
accounts.suspendConfirmBody: All its sessions will be closed and the account will not be able to sign in until it is reactivated.
accounts.reactivateConfirmBody: The account will be able to sign in again.
accounts.deleteStep1Body: Permanent deletion: personal data is erased, published works stay online with no link to the account. Next step: retype the address.
accounts.reset2faConfirmBody: Their device and backup codes will be removed. Verify their identity through another channel before continuing: this is how an account is taken back.

twoFactor.title: Account security
twoFactor.intro: Two-factor authentication asks, at every sign-in, for a one-time code produced by an app (Aegis, FreeOTP, Google Authenticator, 1Password…).
twoFactor.requiredNotice: Your role requires two-factor authentication: turn it on to access your areas.
twoFactor.keyMissing: Two-factor authentication is not yet available on this site (encryption key not configured). Contact the secretariat.
twoFactor.keyDev: Development mode: secrets are encrypted with a test key.
twoFactor.scanTitle: 1. Scan this QR code with your app
twoFactor.confirmTitle: 2. Enter the code shown to confirm
twoFactor.backupHint: Each code works only once, if you no longer have your device. Keep them offline: they will never be shown again.
twoFactor.backupRemaining: {count, plural, =0 {No backup codes left} one {# backup code left} other {# backup codes left}}
twoFactor.regenerateHint: Replaces all existing codes. Enter a current code to confirm.
twoFactor.disableHint: Enter a current code to confirm.
twoFactor.disableLocked: Your role requires two-factor authentication: it cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.challengeSubtitle: Enter the six-digit code shown by your authenticator app.
twoFactor.lostDevice: Lost your device and out of backup codes? Contact the secretariat: an administrator can reset your two-factor authentication after verifying your identity.
twoFactor.err_REPLAYED: This code has just been used. Wait for the next one (30 seconds).
twoFactor.err_NOT_ENABLED: Two-factor authentication is not on for this account.
twoFactor.err_RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
twoFactor.err_TWO_FACTOR_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED: Encryption key not configured on this deployment: enrolment impossible.
twoFactor.err_TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Your role requires two-factor authentication: it cannot be turned off.
twoFactor.policyHint: When on, moderator, editor and administrator accounts must enrol a device before accessing anything.
twoFactor.policyEnableConfirmBody: Moderator and higher accounts without an enrolled device will be taken to the enrolment screen on their next visit.
twoFactor.policyDisableConfirmBody: Staff accounts will again be able to sign in with just their password or email code.
twoFactor.policyWarning: Two-factor authentication is not mandatory for staff. It MUST be turned on at go-live (docs/backlog/comptes.md).
twoFactor.policyKeyMissing: Encryption key TWO_FACTOR_ENCRYPTION_KEY missing: the requirement cannot be turned on.
twoFactor.feedbackPolicyOn: Two-factor authentication now mandatory for staff.
twoFactor.feedbackPolicyOff: Two-factor authentication is no longer mandatory.

orgAdmin.title: My organisation
orgAdmin.none: Your account is not linked to any organisation.
orgAdmin.noneHint: Affiliation happens when a membership application is approved, or through your organisation's manager.
orgAdmin.ficheHint: Your changes are reviewed by a moderator before being published. The current profile stays online meanwhile.
orgAdmin.fieldCountryHint: Two-letter ISO code, for example SN.
orgAdmin.fieldLanguagesHint: ISO codes separated by commas, for example fr, en, wo.
orgAdmin.fieldShowMembers: Show members' names on the public profile
orgAdmin.fieldLogo: Logo (PNG, JPEG or WebP, 1 MB max)
orgAdmin.revisionSubmitted: Changes sent: a moderator will review them.
orgAdmin.pendingNotice: A revision is awaiting a moderator's approval (sent on {date}).
orgAdmin.removeConfirmBody: Their account stays open; it will no longer be linked to the organisation.
orgAdmin.leaveConfirmBody: Your account stays open; your future publications will no longer carry the organisation's name.
orgAdmin.inviteHint: An account is opened for this address if none exists, and a welcome email is sent.
orgAdmin.inviteNoEmail: Colleague linked. No email provider is configured: let them know yourself.
orgAdmin.errGeneric: The action failed. Please try again.
orgAdmin.err_NOT_ORG_MEMBER: You are not linked to this organisation.
orgAdmin.err_LAST_ORG_OWNER: The organisation must keep at least one manager: appoint another one first.
orgAdmin.err_ALREADY_MEMBER: This account is already linked to the organisation.
orgAdmin.err_ORG_MEMBER_LIMIT: Maximum number of members reached: contact the secretariat.
orgAdmin.err_ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED: This account is suspended: only an administrator can reactivate it.
orgAdmin.err_RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Try again later.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_NAME: The name must be between 2 and 120 characters.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_DESCRIPTION: The description is too long (4,000 characters max).
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_WEBSITE: Invalid website address: enter a full address starting with http:// or https://.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_COUNTRY_CODE: Invalid country: enter a two-letter ISO code.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_THEMES: Choose between one and ten themes.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_LANGUAGES: Enter at least one working language.
orgAdmin.err_INVALID_LOGO: This logo has not been checked: upload it again.
orgAdmin.err_LOGO_TOO_LARGE: Logo too large (1 MB max) or empty.
orgAdmin.err_LOGO_TYPE: This file is not a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
orgAdmin.err_LOGO_MISSING: The uploaded file cannot be found: try again.
orgAdmin.publicPublicationsEmpty: No publications from this organisation in the library yet.
orgAdmin.modIntro: Revisions proposed by organisation managers. The public profile only changes on approval.
orgAdmin.modPendingOrg: Profile not published: approval will publish it in the directory.
orgAdmin.modRejectNotes: Reason if declined (sent to the manager)
orgAdmin.modApproveConfirmBody: The public profile is updated immediately.
orgAdmin.modRejectConfirmBody: The online profile does not change; the manager is notified, with the reason if given.
